Name: floor1-swarm-wave
DisplayName: Floor 1 — swarm wave (economy-fed retinue vs locked population)
Description: The real floor-1 fight the growth-site economy actually produces: 40 units (the slice's start_units, all Militia, 80/20 Spearmen/Archer split) against the locked floor-1 population of 250 (85% Fodder / 15% Soldier-melee). Directly tests the headcount-vs-population tension docs/design/scaling-curve.md §3 raised by ratio comparison alone — this scenario runs an actual mechanistic combat model against the same numbers instead.
SourceRefs: docs/design/scaling-curve.md §1 floor-1 composition table (250 population: 85% Fodder / 15% Soldier-melee)
Notes: HeroPresent is false to match the same zero-input convention as the GATE1 calibration fixture, keeping this scenario a fair like-for-like extension rather than mixing in an unmodelled variable. A played run would also have hero DPS and stance play on top of this floor — see docs/sim/LIMITATIONS.md. 40 vs 250 is scaling-curve.md §3's own worst ratio point (6.25, vs the GATE1 calibration ratio of 2.08 at which 110/120 survive) — this scenario is the harness's answer to whether that ratio gap actually produces a wipe under a real combat model, not just a heuristic.
